reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-04-woodland-water.md, round 8 (ddc50a0b). The sheet is rocks.sheet, the woodland's painter (test_the_kits_sheet_is_the_woodlands passes; the woodland's three pictures are byte-identical to f9ef6366). K7-1 fixed: on the ribbon (s < 0.85) the value matches the sibling over all 8 frames (mean 174-186, sd 51-58, east third under 100 L 0.17-0.38, over 230 L 0.38-0.50, no snow 0-3; sibling 177, 57, 0.34, 0.42), and on the whole sheet too (mean 157-166, east half 137-149, under 90 L 0.16-0.18; sibling 161, 135, 0.18). P7-2 fixed (largest bare foot stretch 0-3 columns in any frame). P7-3 fixed (the tongue's tones meet at a different column each row). No water-blue or white on the face beside the baked falls (woodland_kit 44 -> 0, kitlab_tiers 2 -> 0). Fails on K8-1: the shared crest_breaks scales its run lengths with the width but keeps one or two 3-5 texel gaps, so at this width one white run is 64 texels, 2.7 cells, at a nearly constant depth over a straight water-2 shade row: the round-4 lid (K4-2) again. Whitest crest row 0.76 (the sibling 0.65-0.67; round 4's lids were 0.73-0.96). Fix: in rocks.crest_breaks, after the existing draws, split any run longer than 24 texels (the sibling's longest is 23, so the woodland is unchanged) with a 3-5 texel gap; restore the test to whitest row <= 0.70, longest run <= 24, two gaps from two cells up. Also K8-2: the s >= 0.85 navy band is proportional, so it is 15-16 texels wide (the sibling 8-9), one flat water-1 slab of 1259 (sibling 915 over 124 rows) texels, which the gate no longer sees (fall_value now measures only s < 0.85). Fix: navy where xr - X <= min(0.15 (xr - xl), 9) (the woodland unchanged), and gate the band width on the whole sheet. Polish: flat columns 0.35-0.45 across the loop, over the test's 0.42 in frames 2, 4 and 7, which it does not sample (P8-2).
